_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N350310 (2025-07-17, dev split; picked: China-held): CBP held China. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. Target United States; plant capabilities for United States are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: ColdSnap System freeze-on-demand food mixer
product.description: A smart, connected, food-processing mixer-freeze appliance used to create single-serve frozen desserts using proprietary pods. It integrates a refrigeration system, motor and slide assemblies, an evaporator subassembly, a rivet shear subassembly, a frame subassembly, plastic housings, a user interface, and printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) including a main control board.

plants.name: United States Engineering and Programming Facility

components.name: Printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) including main control board
Slide subassembly (slide plate, belt retainer, bearings, motors, scanner)
Evaporator subassembly (evaporator body, end covers, handles, copper tubes)
Rivet shear subassembly (stamped metal frame, mounting hardware, molded plastic parts)
Refrigeration subassembly (copper tube subassemblies, refrigerant, insulation)
Frame subassembly (stamped metal frame, mounting hardware, molded plastic parts)
Wiring harnesses, power supply, QR scanner, and touch screen

operations.name: Populate various electrical components onto a PCB via surface mount technology (SMT)
Permanently load U.S.-developed proprietary software onto the PCBAs
Provision cellular connection on the PCBAs with cloud services provider and test
Cast slide plate and belt retainer; install bearings, fasten motors, install scanner, and test slide subassembly
Extrude evaporator body; braze end covers, laser weld handles, braze copper tubes, and leak/pressure drop test evaporator subassembly
Stamp metal frame, install mounting hardware, injection mold plastic parts, assemble and test rivet shear subassembly
Attach major components to frame; bend, braze, test, install, and couple copper tube subassemblies; evacuate tubing, fill, apply insulation, and test refrigeration subassembly
Stamp metal frame, install mounting hardware, injection mold plastic parts, assemble and test frame subassembly
Injection mold plastic housings, remove flashing, inspect, and screen-print logo
Install and connect power supply, PCBAs, QR scanner, and touch screen
Calibrate and test, install housings, apply stickers, and final packaging
